en: In Korea, think twice before giving your partner these.
The saying goes: give them shoes, and they'll use them to walk away from you.
The one who gets the shoes pays back a coin. Even a hundred won.
Now it's not a gift. They bought them. No gift, no curse.
Would you pay for your own gift?
es: En Corea, piénsalo dos veces antes de regalarle esto a tu pareja.
Dicen que si le regalas zapatos, los usará para alejarse de ti.
Quien recibe los zapatos paga con una moneda. Aunque sea de cien wones.
Ya no es un regalo. Los compró. Sin regalo, no hay maldición.
